name: NapalmSoul lit by the kind after its own
what: UNITE's check reads the chip's kind one up (Fire as Aqua): FireHit1 lights ToadSoul, which BN6's MegaMan does not hold, so UNITE stays grey and NapalmSoul never unites where BN5's does at t1

name: NapalmSoul committed with four turns
what: OK's commit gives NapalmSoul 4 turns where BN5's gives 3 (0x08024FFA): its turns 4 at t1, its end a turn late
